title: Fix warning on the Customer Threads page
issue_title: Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable
issue_body:
#### Description

When saving the imap settings on the backend customer service page the following error is shown.

`Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable`

LINE 1014 = `$errors = imap_errors()` 
this returns a boolean when there are no errors.

LINE 1021 = `if (count($errors) && is_array($errors) {` _[current code]_
This is because the IF-statement which checks the $errors array is in the wrong order.
If nothing is returned from imap_errors() then $errors becomes a boolean which isn't countable

Changing LINE 1021 fixes the issue 
`if (is_array($errors) && count($errors))  {` _[fix code]_
 -> switching the 2 options of the IF-statement

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to 'Customer Service' in the backend
2. Setup IMAP settings & Save
3. Revisit the 'Customer Service' page
4. See error



#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.2
* PHP version: 7.3

#### Describe the bug

There is a problem with the hook actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate.
In the following code, the hook is never called because I have an TransistEmailSendingException but the trackingNumber is updated. The hook should be before email exception.

```
if (!empty($trackingNumber) && $oldTrackingNumber != $trackingNumber) {
            if (!$orderCarrier->sendInTransitEmail($order)) {
                throw new TransistEmailSendingException('An error occurred while sending an email to the customer.');
            }
            $customer = new Customer((int) $order->id_customer);
            $carrier = new Carrier((int) $order->id_carrier, (int) $order->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId());
            Hook::exec('actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate', [
                'order' => $order,
                'customer' => $customer,
                'carrier' => $carrier,
            ], null, false, true, false, $order->id_shop);
        }
```

#### Expected behavior

If there is an error on updating the tracking number should not be updated. But in our case it is updated.
The hook need to be fire before the emailing error.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install the module ps_qualityassurance

title: Fix blocking add to cart button
issue_title: The product-list on the checkout does not work with custom themes
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

This fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 breaks the "Add to cart" buttons in the product-list in all custom themes.

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9


Fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 adds to core.js this code to disable the "Add to cart" button:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

The problem is that all custom themes use this code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
to add the "Add to cart" button in the product-list, which means that after an update to 1.7.8.x all shops with custom themes will have this problem and it is difficult to fix it directly in the theme.

You can go here:
https://addons.prestashop.com/en/3-templates-prestashop
open any theme and check the source code of the "Add to cart" button in the product-list to see that all themes use in the product-list that code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"


#### Expected behavior

The "Add to cart" button should be disabled only on the product page in the form:
form#add-to-cart-or-refresh

In means that this code in the core.js:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

should be replaced with something as this:
$('form#add-to-cart-or-refresh [data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

or this code should be removed from core.js and added to /themes/classic/assets/js/theme.js


#### Steps to Reproduce

1.Install a custom theme with the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

2.Click the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

3.After the popup is closed, all other buttons will be disabled.


**Screenshots**
Before clicking the "Add to cart" button:
https://prnt.sc/18a24cm

after closing the popup, all buttons are disabled:
https://prnt.sc/18a1zux
